text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huuuuh~~? Tact~~~~♡ 
What's the matter~? Spacing out on us~?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah............ No! 
It's nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Hmmmmmm???

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Is Tact homesick?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I bet she totally is~~! 
She was looking at pictures of mountains 
on her phone for ages!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
I see... Tact's hometown is far away, 
so she rarely gets to go back. No matter 
how strong-willed someone is, it's only 
natural to miss home from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, 
let's get some help from someone who knows 
her hometown!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Titleholder, 
you mentioned wanting to run more than 
usual... Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Not really. 
I just felt like it.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: Let's run.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hehe! 
Wait for me, Titleholder!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~ Wild♡ 
Tact looks totally absorbed in it too♡

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, childhood friends really are 
something else! 
With this...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: They haven't come baaaack?!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: Then next—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: It's my turn!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Win Marilyn? 
Oh, what is that wonderful aroma...?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you noticed already. 
Tact, this is for you. You love this, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Erimo roll...! 
Oh my, thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Comforting her through her 
stomach 
with specialties from her hometown!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Thick kombu paired with rich, flavorful 
salmon 
that braved the rough seas... You can 
never go wrong with that.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand always beams whenever she 
eats pork buns from Chinatown too! 
Eating your favorite food always cheers 
you up~~♡

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: She still hasn't bounced back...!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Training in the mountains with a childhood 
friend didn't work, 
and food from her hometown didn't work 
either... Which means what else can we 
do... What's left...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
H-Hrmm...~ 
Does she just have to go home~?
(Ding-dong♪)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
W-What could be going on...? 
Let's follow her!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you so much...! 
I had no idea you would restock it so 
quickly!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The official 'Runaway Bear' stationery... 
I will treasure it...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...What a radiant smile.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, everyone? 
Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Something the matter"...? 
Tact, weren't you homesick~?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Homesick...? 
Why would anyone think that...?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Because you've been staring at photos of 
the mountains 
back home and sighing non-stop lately~!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? Oh, no...! 
The reason I was looking at photos of the 
mountains was... well..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"My favorite 'Escape Bear' merch that I 
always use 
has been sold out for a while now, and—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I asked them to restock it, but while 
waiting, 
I just couldn't settle my mind..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"So, I couldn't help but let my thoughts 
drift back home. 
Thinking... 'the real thing' used to be 
right there..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"The mascot bear is sold out, 
so she starts longing for real bears... 
...Classic Tact."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...So that's what happened. 
I ended up causing everyone 
to worry about me..."
choice_data_list: Can a real bear actually replace that?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes... I truly feel 
so very blessed."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why I want to thank them. 
With matching 'Escape Bear' merch...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"No. You must never approach them in the 
same manner. 
Even I make sure not to get carelessly 
close 
whenever I spot one."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I simply watch from afar, admiring their 
form, 
chiseled by the great wilderness. 
So massive, so round, and so powerful..."

Fully aware of the danger, 
yet overflowing with endless affection— 
such was Daring Tact...
